units.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp reads and writes MSG, CFB, and EML files. It supports both low-level and high-level APIs for structural and semantic access to MAPI message objects.

It reads, builds, and writes generic Compound File Binary containers directly through cfb_reader, cfb_storage/cfb_stream, and cfb_writer, working with file paths, in-memory streams, or raw byte buffers.
It parses and reconstructs the raw MSG directory/stream structure with msg_reader, msg_document, and msg_writer, including an optional strict-validation mode surfaced through validation_issues().

It creates, edits, saves, and reloads Outlook-style messages through mapi_message, setting the subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, and sender identity, or reaching arbitrary MAPI properties via set_property()/get_property_value() with common_message_property_id and property_type_code.

It adds To/Cc/Bcc recipients with add_recipient(), attaches regular files from byte buffers or streams with add_attachment(), and nests a full mapi_message as an embedded-message attachment with add_embedded_message_attachment().
It saves an in-memory mapi_message to .eml and loads .eml back into a mapi_message, both through the library's own MIME engine, with no external MIME dependency.

Aspose.Email FOSS for Cpp provides the mapi_message class as the primary high-level entry point for creating, editing, and reloading messages, while lower-level classes such as msg_reader, msg_document, msg_writer, cfb_reader, cfb_document, and cfb_writer expose the underlying MSG and CFB container structure directly for callers that need it.

The aspose.email.foss namespace hosts the public API surface for MSG and CFB file handling, with mapi_message serving as the main entry point for message operations and supporting creation from scratch, loading from MSG/EML files or streams, and saving back to MSG or EML formats.
It adds mail-protocol connectivity, PST archive support, and broader MAPI property and format coverage across the full commercial product line.
cfb_document class provides methods to load a Compound File Binary document from a buffer, bytes, file, reader, or stream, and exposes its major_version, minor_version, and root.
cfb_exception class represents an exception type for errors in Compound File Binary processing.
cfb_node class represents a node in a Compound File Binary structure and provides access to its name, clsid, creation_time, modified_time, and indicates whether it is a storage or stream.
cfb_reader class reads a Compound File Binary document and provides access to its header, directory_entries, fat, mini_fat, difat, and methods to find and retrieve stream data.
cfb_storage class represents a storage node in a Compound File Binary document and provides methods to add child storages and streams, and to access its children.
cfb_stream class represents a stream node in a Compound File Binary document and provides methods to get and set its data.
cfb_writer class writes a Compound File Binary document and provides methods to write to a file, stream, or return the result as bytes.
directory_color_flag enum lists the black and red color flags used in the directory of a Compound File Binary document.

directory_entry class represents an entry in the directory of a Compound File Binary document and provides access to its child_id, clsid, color_flag, creation_time, directory_entry_name_length, and indicates whether it is a root, storage, or stream.
directory_object_type enum lists the root_storage_object, storage_object, stream_object, and unknown_or_unallocated object types used in the directory of a Compound File Binary document.

header class represents the header of a Compound File Binary document and provides access to its byte_order, first_difat_sector_location, first_directory_sector_location, first_mini_fat_sector_location, header_clsid, header_signature, and major_version.
sector_marker enum lists the difsect, endofchain, fatsect, and freesect markers used in the sector allocation tables of a Compound File Binary document.

common_message_property_id enum lists the attach_content_id, attach_data_binary, attach_filename, attach_long_filename, attach_method, attach_mime_tag, body, body_html, display_bcc, display_cc, display_name, and display_to property identifiers for MAPI messages.
mapi_attachment class represents a MAPI attachment and provides access to its content_id, data, embedded_message, filename, and methods to load data or determine if it is an embedded message.
mapi_message class represents a MAPI message and provides methods to add attachments and recipients, and access its body and attachments.
mapi_property class represents a MAPI property and provides methods to get and set its flags, property_id, property_tag, property_type, and value.
mapi_property_collection class represents a collection of MAPI properties and provides methods to add, get, set, remove, and access items.
mapi_recipient class represents a MAPI recipient and provides access to its address_type, display_name, email_address, properties, and recipient_type.

msg_document class represents a MSG document and provides methods to load it from a file, reader, or stream, and exposes its major_version, minor_version, root, and a method to convert it to a cfb_document.
msg_exception class represents an exception type for errors in MSG processing.
msg_reader class reads a MSG document and provides methods to load it from a file or stream, and exposes its cfb document and validation_issues.
msg_storage class represents a storage node in a MSG document and provides access to its clsid, creation_time, modified_time, name, and methods to add child storages and streams.
msg_storage_role enum lists the attachment, custom_attachment, embedded_message, generic, message, named_property_mapping, and recipient roles for MSG storages.
msg_stream class represents a stream node in a MSG document and provides access to its clsid, creation_time, data, modified_time, and name.
msg_writer class writes a MSG document and provides methods to write to a file, stream, or return the result as bytes.

property_type_code enum lists the ptyp_binary, ptyp_boolean, ptyp_currency, ptyp_error_code, ptyp_floating32, ptyp_floating64, ptyp_floating_time, ptyp_guid, ptyp_integer16, ptyp_integer32, ptyp_integer64, and ptyp_multiple_binary property type codes for MAPI properties.
